description:
Log into LibreHealth EHR and create a new document category named 'Telehealth Consent'.

1. Log in with username: 'admin' and password: 'password'.
2. Navigate to Administration > Other > Document Categories.
3. In the category tree, add a new category named 'Telehealth Consent' as a child of the root 'Categories' folder.
4. Save the new category.
